svg.title: Defense-in-depth security, privacy and compliance layers
svg.desc: Four security and legal pillars: 1. edge & transport security (Turnstile, CSP, Trusted Types, HSTS), 2. authentication & cryptography (WebAuthn passkeys, AES-256-GCM BYOK envelope encryption, SSRF guard), 3. EU law & data protection (GDPR Art. 15/17/20, EU AI Act Art. 50, TDDDG, DDG), 4. accessibility & supply chain (WCAG 2.2 AAA, OpenSSF Scorecard, CodeQL, osv-scanner).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Defense in depth: security, GDPR, EU AI Act Art. 50 & WCAG 2.2 AAA

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Security by design & privacy by default · Zero unencrypted API keys · Zero tracking cookies · Full supply-chain checks
